en.headline: Government requires MTR to submit Lam Tin investigation report within one month
en.dek: Transport Secretary Mable Chan said the government is very concerned about the two incidents at Lam Tin station within 15 hours and has asked the MTR Corporation for a full review and report.
body: The Transport and Logistics Bureau has required the MTR Corporation to complete a thorough investigation into the successive incidents at Lam Tin station and submit a report within one month, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Wednesday.

Chan said the government is very concerned about the events. On Tuesday afternoon, an insulating component on a track switch near the station caught fire, disrupting services. On Wednesday morning, platform equipment emitted smoke, forcing trains to skip the station and the station to close temporarily for about an hour.

The MTR has said both issues have been resolved and services have returned to normal. The operator arranged free shuttle buses between Kwun Tong and Yau Tong stations during the disruptions. Chan said the corporation must address the immediate problems properly before conducting the comprehensive review.
Passengers affected by the Wednesday incident reported delays of 10 to 30 minutes. Local residents noted the inconvenience of two disruptions in consecutive days at the same station.

zh.headline: 政府要求港鐵一個月內就藍田站事故提交調查報告
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，政府非常關注藍田站不足15小時內兩度發生事故，已要求港鐵深入全面調查並於一個月內提交報告。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周三表示，政府非常關注港鐵藍田站接連發生的事故，已要求港鐵在妥善處理當前問題後，進行深入及全面的調查，並於一個月內提交報告。
周二傍晚，藍田站路軌旁道岔設備一件絕緣膠疑因短路起火，觀塘綫服務一度受阻。周三早上，站內月台設備冒煙，列車一度不停該站，車站暫時關閉約一小時。港鐵表示情況已處理好，服務陸續恢復正常。
事故期間，港鐵安排免費接駁巴士來往觀塘至油塘站。陳美寶指出，港鐵需先妥善處理眼前問題，再進行全面檢視。受影響乘客表示行程延誤十多至半小時，有居民對連續兩日在同一車站發生事故感到失望。
港鐵較早時已就路軌火警公布相關畫面，並表示會就事件成因進行深入調查。
